chunks: Al-ʿAlāʾ narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams عليهما السلام, who said:
If a man has intercourse with the slave woman of his wife, then upon him is what is upon the fornicator.

key_terms.مَا عَلَى الزَّانِي: the legal liability or punishment incurred by a fornicator

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man has intercourse with his wife's slave woman?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man who has intercourse with his wife's slave woman. It states that he incurs the same liability as a fornicator, indicating the prohibition and penal consequence of the act in Shia fiqh.
